name: 纸纪
description: 源自 rico-md 的「纸纪」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px 16px 32px 16px; font-family: Noto Sans SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.9; color: {{text}}; background-color: rgba(26, 26, 24, 0.02); word-wrap: break-word">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-family: Noto Serif SC, Songti SC, STSong, Georgia, serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.4; margin: 32px 0 24px; word-break: break-all">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-family: Noto Serif SC, Songti SC, STSong, Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.4; margin: 28px 0 20px; word-break: break-all">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-family: Noto Serif SC, Songti SC, STSong, Georgia, serif; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a18; line-height: 1.4; margin: 24px 0 16px; word-break: break-all">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading4.html: <{{tag}} style="font-family: Noto Serif SC, Songti SC, STSong, Georgia, serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a18; line-height: 1.4; margin: 20px 0 12px; word-break: break-all">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

paragraph.html: {{content}}

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background: rgba(207, 68, 54, 0.06); padding: 12px 16px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 2px solid {{border}}; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a18">{{content}}</th>

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

divider.html: <hr style="margin: 0 auto; border: none; border-top: 1px solid {{border}}; max-width: 100%">
